name: Glory View Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Glory View Technology Co., Ltd. provides smart city solutions and computing power services in China and internationally. The company offers smart city solutions for smart healthcare, smart education, smart communities, smart buildings, smart government affairs, and smart parks, which include preliminary consultation, solution design, equipment procurement, software development, and system integration. It also provides computing power integration and operation services, such as system design, equipment supply, modification and optimization, installation and commissioning, networking, and operation and maintenance services for computing power clusters.
